attributes.name: card image alt text
attributes.definition: How alternative text is provided for images inside cards.

values.definition: Card images have empty alt attributes.
Card images have meaningful alt text.
No card images or not addressed.

attributes.name: card content completeness
attributes.definition: Whether cards contain full body content (description, link) or leave parts empty.

values.definition: Some cards lack body text or links, leaving blank space.
All cards have complete body content.

attributes.name: card title overflow treatment
attributes.definition: How long card titles are handled when they exceed available space.

values.definition: Titles are cut off with an ellipsis.

attributes.name: card icon sizing
attributes.definition: How small icons placed beside card text are sized and proportioned.

values.definition: Icons render at small inline sizes, some with distorted aspect ratios.
Icons render at small inline sizes with correct aspect ratios.
No inline icons beside card text.
